# Pinned upstream conformance fixtures

These feature files are copied unchanged from Karate commit `00d0fc9efdbbfe632005af69224bb07b3848d85a`. `manifest.json` records paths and SHA-256 hashes; the upstream MIT license is retained.

The native engine executes the XML call and copy/scoping files (seven scenarios) with serial and parallel scheduling. Their helpers retain the original `@ignore` tags and run only when called. This is a small executable upstream corpus, not an exhaustive differential run of Karate.
